errorRules.message: ModelArk answered HTTP 401 (code AuthenticationError). The error-codes page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes) lists the message "The API key or AK/SK in the request is missing or invalid." and the description "Please check the authentication credentials or troubleshoot based on the API document." NeuroLink reads the key from {apiKeyEnvVar}. API key page: {setupUrl}

ModelArk reports this account has not activated model {model} (HTTP 404 ModelNotOpen). The error-codes page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes) says "Please activate the model service in the Ark Console."

errorRules.pattern: model or endpoint .* does not exist or you do not have access to it
errorRules.message: ModelArk reports the model or endpoint {model} does not exist or you do not have access to it (HTTP 404 InvalidEndpointOrModel.NotFound).

ModelArk reports this account has exhausted its free trial quota for model {model} (HTTP 429 QuotaExceeded). The error-codes page says to activate the corresponding model service on the Activation page: https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes

ModelArk reports this account has reached the set inference limit for model {model} and the model service has been paused (HTTP 429 SetLimitExceeded). See https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-tokens-only-mode

ModelArk reports this account has an overdue balance (HTTP 403 AccountOverdueError). The error-codes page says to go to the BytePlus Billing Center to recharge: https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes

instructions: 1. Visit: https://console.byteplus.com/auth/signup and register as a BytePlus user — the Inference free trial page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-inference-quota) says "Register and authenticate as a BytePlus user."

2. Activate the models you want to call on the Model activation page (https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/openManagement) — the Quick start (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/quick-start) says "Go to the Model activation page to activate the models you need to use."

3. Create an API key at https://ai.byteplus.com/ark/region:ap-southeast-1/apiKey — the Quick start says to "create or obtain a ModelArk API key"; the API key page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/api-key) says "API Key is isolated by region. Select the appropriate region before creating and using the API Key for authentication."

4. Free trial, as the vendor states it: "ModelArk offers new users a free inference trial quota, allowing them to get started at no cost." (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-inference-quota); the Free Tokens Only mode page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-tokens-only-mode) says "In this mode, calls to the inference API consume only the 500k free tokens granted by the platform."
5. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} in your .env file (the vendor's examples read ARK_API_KEY)
setup.description: Docs-verified only, not yet live-verified: the vendor's GET https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 without one), so the 12 model ids come from the Model list page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/model-list, Text generation table, retrieved 2026-09-29) and the roster has not been checked. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3: the vendor's Compatible with OpenAI API page (https://docs.byteplus.com/api/docs/ModelArk/1330626) says "ModelArk model APIs are largely compatible with the OpenAI SDK." and sets base_url="https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3" in the OpenAI Python SDK; the Chat API page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/1494384) documents POST https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3/chat/completions. The Region availability page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/region-availability) lists a second base URL, https://ark.eu-west.bytepluses.com/api/v3; set BYTEPLUS_MODELARK_BASE_URL to use it. On that page, the section "Models supported in the EU region" has the sentence "The EU region currently supports the following models:" followed by a one-item list, seed-2-0-lite; separately, a tip on the Model list page says "The seed-2-0 and seedream-5-0-lite models are also supported in the eu-west-1 region." The Region availability page says "Platform-level resources, such as API keys and model activation status, are isolated by region." Unauthenticated GETs made 2026-09-29: /models and /chat/completions each answered HTTP 401 with a JSON body whose error.code is AuthenticationError and error.type is Unauthorized; no POST request was sent. errorRules: the 401 rule follows that observation and the AuthenticationError row of https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes, and the pattern rules follow the messages on https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/error-codes (ModelNotOpen, InvalidEndpointOrModel.NotFound, QuotaExceeded, AccountOverdueError) and https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-tokens-only-mode (SetLimitExceeded). models.defaultContextWindow (128000) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) apply to model ids outside the catalog and are placeholders the vendor does not publish for those ids; 4096 is the max_tokens default on the Chat API page. No per-model maxOutputTokens is set. Each model's status field holds production (preview for the model id containing the word preview), a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. Each model's vision field is true for a model that the Visual understanding table on the Model list page lists; for glm-5-2-260617, deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813 and deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731, vision is false as a schema placeholder for a boolean the catalog requires; it is not a vendor statement. capabilities.tools is model-dependent: the Function call page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/function-calling) documents tools and points to the Model list Tool use table for the models that support it. capabilities.toolsWithStreaming is true because that page has a Streaming output section whose example passes tools with stream=True. capabilities.structuredOutput is a boolean for the entry and is true because the Structured output (beta) page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/structured-output-beta) documents response_format with json_schema mode and the Chat API page lists response_format types text, json_schema and json_object. The Chat API page says of response_format "For models that support this parameter, see documentation." and the Model list Structured output (beta) section lists these non-retired model ids: dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628, seed-2-0-lite-260428, seed-2-0-mini-260428, seed-2-0-lite-260228, seed-2-0-mini-260215, deepseek-v4-1-flash-260910, deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813, deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731. The NeuroLink default seed-2-0-pro-260328 is not in that section, and its Text generation row lists Deep reasoning; Text generation; Multi-modal understanding; Tool Calling. capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools is false because no request combining them was sent. capabilities.thinking is false: the Deep reasoning page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/deep-thinking) documents the thinking request field, and the entry sets no thinking-level request parameter. capabilities.embeddings is false: the Model list has a separate Multimodal embedding section with its own API, and this entry lists chat models. billingPolicy holds the schema value free-tier because the Inference free trial page (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/free-inference-quota) states a free inference trial quota for new users; apiKeyFormat is null so NeuroLink's key-format check is not applied.
